title: My Week
text:
My week starts on Monday. On Monday I go to school. On Tuesday I play football with my friend Tom. On Wednesday we go to the park.

On Thursday I visit my grandmother. On Friday I cook pizza for my family. On Saturday and Sunday I rest at home. I like the weekend very much.

questions.text: What sport does the writer play with Tom on Tuesday?
Who does the writer visit on Thursday?
Why does the writer probably like the weekend?
options: Because school is very hard on weekends
Because the writer can rest and spend time with family
Because the park is always closed
Because the writer has no food at home

questions.text: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Every day of the week is exactly the same
The writer has a different routine each day and enjoys the weekend
The writer does not like going outside

vocabulary.definition: a sport where two teams try to kick a ball into a goal
the mother of your mother or father
to make food by heating it
to relax and not do hard work

paragraph_translations: Mój tydzień zaczyna się w poniedziałek. W poniedziałek chodzę do szkoły. We wtorek gram w piłkę nożną z moim przyjacielem Tomem. W środę idziemy do parku.
W czwartek odwiedzam moją babcię. W piątek gotuję pizzę dla mojej rodziny. W sobotę i niedzielę odpoczywam w domu. Bardzo lubię weekend.
